name: Last-Mile Tracking
one_liner: Distribution-to-patient visibility with delivery confirmation, proof of delivery and returns.
fits_when: specialty or cold-chain packs are delivered from a pharmacy or hub to the patient's home or clinic
several courier partners deliver and each must see only its own deliveries
delivery has to be confirmed with OTP, signature or photo and a serial scan at the door
deliveries carry a promised-by time and late ones must surface before they breach
failed attempts, temperature excursions and damaged packs need a signed-off exception record
packs that come back must be scanned, received and dispositioned (restock, quarantine, destroy)
gives_you: A delivery lifecycle from booking through hand-over, out for delivery, failed attempts and delivery or return
Serial scans at hand-over, at the door and on return, checked against packaging line (L3) serials
Proof of delivery with method, recipient, door temperature and photo, verified or disputed by ops
Route exceptions (delays, excursions, damage, address issues) acknowledged and signed off with root cause
Returns approved, collected by the partner, received with a serial scan and closed with a disposition
A delivery 360 page and a control-tower dashboard of SLA risk by partner and region

catalogue.description: Last-mile visibility for medicines that travel from a dispatching pharmacy to the patient: the pharmacy books the delivery and scans the serial at hand-over, the logistics partner takes it out for delivery and captures proof at the door, and supply chain ops watches every delivery against its promised-by time. Failed attempts, temperature excursions and damaged packs become route exceptions that ops signs off; packs that come back move through an approved, collected, received and dispositioned return. Couriers and pharmacies sign in to see only their own deliveries.

roles.name: Supply Chain Ops
roles.description: Central team: watches SLAs, verifies proof of delivery, signs off route exceptions, closes returns and manages partners and routes

workflows.name: Delivery tracking
workflows.description: Booked, handed over with a serial scan, out for delivery, failed attempts, delivered or returned, with SLA status and breach flags

workflows.name: Proof of delivery
workflows.description: OTP, e-signature or photo with a serial scan and door temperature; verified or disputed by ops

workflows.name: Returns
workflows.description: Requested, approved with a pick-up date, collected, received with a serial scan and closed with a disposition posted to the ERP

workflows.name: Route exceptions
workflows.description: Delays, excursions, damage and address issues raised on the road, acknowledged and signed off with root cause and corrective action

compliance: Serial verification at hand-over, delivery and return against packaging line data
Cold-chain packs only on cold-chain routes with qualified partners; door temperature recorded
Patient pseudonymised: deliveries carry a programme ID, not a patient name
Row-level access: each partner and pharmacy sees only its own deliveries
Audit trail of every scan, status change, proof and exception sign-off
catalogue.app_prompt_prefill: Last-mile tracking for specialty and cold-chain medicines delivered from 6 dispatch pharmacies to about 2,400 patients' homes a month by 3 courier partners across Maharashtra and Karnataka. The pharmacy scans the serial at hand-over, the courier captures OTP and a serial scan at the door with the door temperature for cold-chain packs, and supply chain ops watches on-time delivery against a 24-hour promise. Failed attempts and temperature excursions become route exceptions that ops signs off, with excursions also signed off by QA, and returned packs are scanned back and dispositioned.
